reason: A native DeepSeek Harness plugin providing local-first and cloud-synchronized agent memory, including recall, state continuity, timelines, TODOs, decisions, progress snapshots, authentication, and synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供支持离线队列的本地优先记忆、状态连续性以及与 XMemo 云端服务同步的工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with local-first memory, offline write queuing, state continuity, and synchronization with the XMemo cloud service.

capabilities: Stores agent state, memories, timelines, TODOs, decisions, and progress snapshots locally
Synchronizes memory data with the XMemo MemoryOS REST API
Supports OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and static API-key authentication
Provides a web GUI card for authentication and memory-mode configuration
Supports recoverable deletion and offline write queuing
